item.title: Could the Milky Way galaxy's supermassive black hole actually be a clump of dark matter?
item.description: New research suggests that the heart of the Milky Way may be dominated by a dense clump of dark matter rather than the supermassive black hole Sagittarius A*.

item.title: February's full Snow Moon glows behind snowdrops in ethereal winter photo
item.description: The full "Snow Moon" rose on Feb. 1 to flood the winter sky with icy moonlight.

item.title: Europe's most powerful rocket launches for 1st time, carrying 32 Amazon internet satellites to orbit (video)
item.description: The most powerful version of Europe's Ariane 6 rocket flew for the first time ever on Thursday (Feb. 12), launching 32 of Amazon's internet satellites to orbit.

item.title: SpaceX Crew-12 launch latest news: NASA ISS astronaut crew ready to fly
item.description: Thursday, Feb. 12, 2026: Updates on SpaceX and NASA's Crew-12 astronaut launch to the International Space Station.

item.title: Astronomers witness vanishing star collapse into a black hole in Andromeda galaxy
item.description: Astronomers tracked a star in Andromeda as it dimmed and vanished without the usual fiery explosion, offering rare clues to how black holes form.

item.title: Scientists have found a weird 'inside out' planetary system. Here's what it looks like
item.description: Astronomers have discovered a planetary system that appears to flip one of astronomy's most reliable rules on its head.

item.title: Deja vu: Vulcan Centaur rocket powers through 'significant performance anomaly' on satellite launch
item.description: A Vulcan Centaur rocket successfully launched two U.S. spy satellites on Feb. 12 despite suffering an anomaly with one of its solid rocket boosters, echoing the result of an October 2024 mission.

item.title: Watch SpaceX launch Crew-12 astronaut mission to the International Space Station this morning
item.description: SpaceX will launch the latest batch of astronauts to the International Space Station early Friday morning (Feb. 13), and you can watch the action live.
